create_RobotCameraParams: create a RobotCameraParams instance to configure camera placement on a robot link with offset and orientation
create_MobileManipulatorParams: create a MobileManipulatorParams instance to configure arm joints, gripper joints, cameras, and motor gains for a mobile manipulator
build_MobileManipulator: build a MobileManipulator robot by passing params, a URDF path, and a Habitat simulator instance
run_MobileManipulator_reconfigure: run the reconfigure method on a MobileManipulator to load the URDF and set initial joint and motor state
run_MobileManipulator_reset: run the reset method on a MobileManipulator to reset arm and gripper joint motors to their initial state
